Subject: Quick intake: Hosted API eval request — Lumina Analytics

Hi team,

Inbound from a self-serve signup — Lumina Analytics (contact: Sophie Lang). Lead filled in the quick intake form and requested a 30-min technical session to evaluate the Hosted API for a PoC around real-time summarization and embedding search. Key details from the intake (attached):
- Company: Lumina Analytics (series B, fintech analytics)
- Use case: ingest ~500M tokens/month, real-time summaries for customer-facing dashboards, embedding store for similarity search
- Priority: evaluate latency and cost estimates, ask about private routing and token quota options
- Requested window: "Week of Jul 26, mornings PT" (they're in PDT)

Sophie also included a short note: "We spun up the trial and hit the rate limit when testing 2k token requests — would love to understand rate-limiting options and expected per-token cost at scale."

I've added the HubSpot record (link below) and attached the intake PDF. Can one of you take point on the demo? Ideal outcome: 30-min hosted API technical eval, follow-on PoC kickoff if fit.

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890
Intake: lumina-lead-intake.pdf (attached)

Thanks,
Aditya

- Wed, Jul 28: 08:30–09:00 or 10:00–10:45

Hi Vivek — thanks for reaching out and thanks Aditya for the intro.

The windows you proposed on Tue/Wed mornings PT are close — we have a standing leadership review at 09:30 on Tue that runs 30–45 min. Could we do Wed Jul 28 at 10:00 PT (that would be perfect), or Wed Jul 28 at 16:00 PT if mornings are tied up?

A couple requests so we can make the time productive:
- Please include an API/infra engineer so we can cover rate limits, autoscaling and multi-tenant routing.
- Can you confirm we will get sandbox credentials or a short-lived API key to exercise the flow during the call? If you can pre-provision embedding bucket/storage recommendations, that would be helpful.

Short context on our side: we run near-real-time data pipelines for customer dashboards (500M tokens/month as Aditya noted). We’re evaluating tradeoffs between serving from a hosted inference tier vs. a dedicated/reserved pool — main concerns are tail latency (95/99th), cost per embed, and data retention/compliance.

If Wed 10:00 PT works, please send an invite and include relevant technical folks. Looking forward to it.

—Sophie
Sophie Lang | VP, Product | Lumina Analytics
